Game Overview

At its heart, Starvore is a io game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Starvore doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Starvore?

Starvore is a free io game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Starvore free to play?

Yes, Starvore is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
